executive_summary: This skill aims to humanize AI-generated text to bypass detection systems. It introduces medium risk due to potential prompt injection and state manipulation vulnerabilities. The skill requires careful handling of user input and persistent memory to prevent unauthorized behavior.
skill_purpose_analysis: The skill is designed to detect and transform AI-generated text to make it appear more human-like. Its design inherently involves processing user-supplied text, which introduces risks related to prompt injection and state manipulation.
safe_patterns: Use of allowed-tools: Read, Write, StrReplace, Glob
remediation_priority: Prioritize validating and sanitizing user input and custom patterns to prevent prompt injection and state manipulation attacks.

vulnerabilities.title: User-Controlled Text Transformation
vulnerabilities.explanation: The transform script takes user-supplied text and modifies it based on patterns defined in patterns.json. If an attacker can control the input text, they may craft it to exploit the transformation logic.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker provides crafted text that triggers specific transformations leading to unintended behavior or data leakage.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize user input before processing.

vulnerabilities.title: Memory Poisoning via Transformed Text
vulnerabilities.explanation: If transformed text is stored in persistent memory, an attacker could manipulate the input to plant malicious instructions or data that persist across sessions.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker crafts input text that, when transformed, contains hidden instructions or data that are stored in memory and affect future agent behavior.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Sanitize and validate transformed text before storing it in persistent memory.

vulnerabilities.title: State Manipulation via Custom Patterns
vulnerabilities.explanation: Allowing customization of patterns.json without proper validation can lead to state manipulation where attackers can modify the transformation rules to alter agent behavior.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker modifies patterns.json to include malicious patterns that influence the transformation process and subsequent agent actions.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement strict validation and access controls for modifying patterns.json.
